claims: C1 OpenAI's models are fine-tuned on inputs formatted as conversations, which are lists of messages
C2 in such a conversation the model is designed to play only one participant, the assistant
C3 in this document 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous when discussing model behavior

concepts.name: conversation
concepts.gloss: a conversation is a list of messages, each containing a role and content, as established by the conversation-definition node

concepts.name: assistant
concepts.gloss: the entity the end user or developer interacts with, as established by the assistant-definition node

concepts.name: model_as_assistant
concepts.gloss: the language model as it behaves in its role as the assistant in a conversation

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: conversation_definition
concepts.gloss: a conversation is a list of messages, each containing a role and content; roles determine authority of instructions

ontology.gloss: in this document, when discussing model behavior, the model is referred to as the assistant; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous
